ana (PM): Heads-up — rolling out the 'rollback gatekeeper' UX for auto-fallback. Need alignment on notifications and SLA signals.

mike (eng): quick Q: should gatekeeper block automatic rollbacks that would breach SLA windows? or just warn?

tara (ops): prefer block for first 15m, then allow soft rollback. if latency spike persists >15m, let it fallback but notify.

simon (designer): thinking: make operator confirmation a 2-step modal only if cost increase > X or SLA risk flagged. default small rollbacks auto.

ana (PM): @tara what's the concrete SLA threshold? p95 latency > 800ms? or error rate + latency combo?

mike (eng): impl-wise we have 'slo_risk' boolean from telemetry. If true, we can set `rollback_mode=manual`.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: telemetry hook ✅; audit-log hook ✅; operator-inbox ✅

tara (ops): Also need an escape hatch: operator can 'force rollback' regardless of gatekeeper. audit entry required.

mike (eng): agreed. audit log must capture operator id + reason. propose payload: 
```
{ "action": "force_rollback", "actor": "username", "reason": "string", "slo_snapshot": {...} }
```

simon (designer): UI note: when gatekeeper blocks, show "why" with three bullets: SLO impact, cost impact, recent error bursts. small icon to expand.

ana (PM): What about quota interplay? rollback might trigger higher token usage if we switch models.

tara (ops): Good catch. We should surface projected cost delta in the modal before operator confirms. even a rough %.

mike (eng): telemetry can estimate token delta from recent throughput — ~95th percentile. add to payload as `proj_cost_delta`.

ana (PM): Can we send an automated slack DM to oncall if gatekeeper blocks for >5m? Ops want urgency.

tara (ops): yes please. DM + create incident draft in ops console.

mike (eng): Implementation plan: gatekeeper service maintains state machine: ALLOW -> BLOCKED -> ESCALATED. We'll emit events to audit stream at each transition.

ana (PM): timeline? sync with rollout next Wed.

simon (designer): mock coming by EOD today.

mike (eng): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gatekeeper/pull/42 — adds `slo_risk` hook + audit entries.

ops-bot: incident-draft created: #gatekeeper-block-4141592653 by ops-bot

tara (ops): tiny UX detail: when gatekeeper blocks, operators should be able to preview "simulated rollback" results (latency/cost) before forcing.

mike (eng): we can add a dry-run mode calling the routing-sim to produce sample request traces.

ana (PM): ok next steps: 
- mike: finish PR + add proj_cost_delta
- simon: mock + expandable why panel
- tara: onboard oncall DM rule
- ana: prepare release note

mike (eng): ack. will add audit schema to docs.

simon (designer): ack

tara (ops): ack

ana (PM): thanks team :tada:

mike (eng): one more Q: retain audit logs for how long? legal asked 1yr.

tara (ops): 13 months is fine. ops-bot will be configured.

ops-bot: audit-retention updated to 13 months

mike (eng): closing thread, will ping when PR merged.
